entries.6cb1dc62cbff41cc: Guided by its corporate philosophy, “More Fun,” the company aims to maximize the value of its IP as an IP creator and developer leading the entertainment market for women. The company will continue into the 13th fiscal period the three pillars of its growth strategy adopted from the 11th fiscal period: “Game Business,” “Media Business,” and “AI Utilization and Others.” Its aim is to enhance the value of its own IP through both long-term operation of titles and new development, and to expand points of contact with fans through stores and events in the Media Business. Under a user-first principle, the company will focus on providing content with high customer satisfaction.
